t: May Allah reward such and such man who straightened the curve, cured the disease abondoned mischief and established the sunnah. He departed (from this world) with untarnished clothes and little shortcomings.
He achieved good (of this world) and remained safe from its evils.
He offered Allah's obedience and feared Him as He deserved. He went away and left the people in dividing ways wherein the misled cannot obtain guidance and the guided cannot attain certainty.
